title: Same model, different channel ID
summary: Direct API, Bedrock, Vertex, Azure/Foundry, and OpenRouter do not share slugs. Copying a Claude API ID into Bedrock is the second-most common stale-access failure after Haiku 3.
examples: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (Anthropic API) vs anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 (Bedrock) vs claude-haiku-4-5@20251001 (Vertex)
OpenAI-compatible base_url on api.x.ai/v1 still needs XAI keys and xAI slugs
Gemini AI Studio key is not a Vertex service account
